basic_info.description:
This spacious, sunny 1458-square foot North Beach condominium offers stunning Bay Bridge and water views with gleaming hardwood floors throughout. Located in a professionally managed, secure building, it includes a doorman, an assigned gated garage parking space, a reservable event or cooking space with a library, and access to the building's gym.

Ideally situated within walking distance of vibrant North Beach restaurants, nightlife, shopping (Trader Joe's), the Embarcadero, Coit Tower, and Levi Plaza Park. Easy access to public transit and excellent City walking!

The home features a formal entry with a hallway closet. The open floor plan includes a sun-filled living room with spectacular views and a large formal dining room that can easily accommodate 8-10 guests. The kitchen has stone countertops, a dishwasher, refrigerator, oven, cooktop, microwave, and a separate food pantry. There's also a kitchen dining counter for casual dining. The unit has a new Samsung washer/dryer.

The two bedrooms offer ample closet space and each has its own en-suite full bathroom. One bathroom has a deep soaking tub, the other a walk-in shower. The primary bedroom is very spacious with plenty of room for an additional private sitting area or home office.

Rent includes garbage and building amenities such as the gym, assigned garage parking spot, communal event space, and patio areas. Rental excludes water, electricity, and high-speed internet, which average about $45 total per month.

The assigned and gated garage parking spot includes an EV charger.

Move-in requirements: First month's rent, last month's rent, and 1-month security deposit.

Pet Policy: Subject to approval. A pet deposit of $500 is required, which is fully refundable if there is no damage.

Condo is unfurnished.

Video tour video available upon request. Message me via zillow, and I'll send it.

Owner covers trash, gas, water, and HOA fees. Renter is responsible for Comcast and electric. Last month's rent and security deposit required at signing. No smoking permitted. Pets are allowed, but no pets have previously lived on the property, ideal for those with allergies.
